MS17 service Claim succeeds/local directory fails: retain staged Core and Claimed journal, never delete

MS21 every durable target write prefix recovers with a fresh storage object and same service Claim

MS25 another claimant wins: no target publication, unchanged Core/files and retained target journal
MS26 local already published/service unavailable denies opening and recovery, no rollback deletion
MS27 historical Claim receipt cannot reopen or republish after migration back to A
MS28 malformed journal, cross-account/device, duplicate migration or changed payload never overwrite original logs
MS29 final synchronous authority guard closes async-observation→Core-write service unavailability gap
MS30 published progression may open, while immutable FormatTime/forkOrigin mutation remains rejected
MS31 no pending recovery is diagnostic only; account isolation and reentrant coordinator refuse
MS32 inherited fork origin survives unchanged through same-ID migration and no account facts are transferred
MS33 local publication survives a missing service domain; never invent registration or delete the target
MS34 source Prepared/PauseActive/Released/Claimed durable phases survive new storage instances without source mutation
